blurb: Parasailing offers a one-of-a-kind thrill that blends the serenity of flight with the rush of adventure. As you're gently lifted into the sky, the noise of the world below fades, replaced by a quiet breeze and breathtaking panoramic views. Whether you’re soaring over sparkling ocean waves or taking in the coastline from above, the experience is both peaceful and exhilarating-a perfect balance of adrenaline and awe

checkin: We are located on Dock 2 in front of Turks Bar near Dana Wharf Sportfishing and Whale Watching as well as the Wind and Sea restaurant. Once parked, please follow the signs to the Dana Wharf Sportfishing and Whale Watching, turn right towards the docks, Dock 2 will have a Dana Point Parasail sign for easy locating. Please wait at the top of the dock at the designated sign for check-in and boarding.
cancellation: Customers will receive a full refund with 24 hours notice of cancellation. If you cancel within 24 hours there will be a $25 cancellation fee per passenger. Customers using vouchers or gift certificates will forfeit said voucher or gift certificate if canceling within 24 hours of trip departure.

faq.a: When parasailing, you ride under a parachute that is being towed by a speedboat. There is very little physical effort involved – you mostly need to enjoy the incredible views from up to 800 feet in the air! Both the launch and landing are done from the back of the specialized parasailing boat so there’s no need to take a swim (though you may get a little wet from spray)!
